calls.body: The Avalanche have been one of the league’s best at controlling the chances at 5-on-5, and the Predators near the bottom. Expect the Avalanche to spend more of the night in the Predators’ end. That’s about the puck, not the scoreboard: goalies and finishing decide plenty of games the chances don’t.

surprises.head: Nashville shut down Colorado’s power play
surprises.body: Colorado’s power play created 0.9 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.3 (about 6.9 against Nashville) and a league average of 7.7. A team strays this far about once every 60 games.

story.head: Drury scores against his old team
paras: Filip Forsberg opened the scoring for the Predators on the power play early in the first, and Steven Stamkos made it 2-0 midway through the period. The second was all Predators: Ryan O'Reilly scored on the power play, Jack Drury scored, and O'Reilly scored his second of the night on the power play to make it 5-0. Parker Kelly and Jayden Struble fought midway through the second, and Artturi Lehkonen got the Avalanche on the board late in the period. Devon Toews cut Nashville’s lead to 5-2 early in the third. Stamkos struck again on the power play midway through the period to make it 6-2 for the Predators. O'Reilly added two assists for a four-point night, and Stamkos had an assist for a three-point night.
The Predators drove the play, outshooting the Avalanche 35-21, and the scoreboard caught up. Justus Annunen made 19 saves for the Predators, and Scott Wedgewood allowed six goals on 35 shots.

Special teams did the work: the Predators scored four power-play goals on seven chances and killed all four Avalanche power plays. The Preds improved to 4-3-4 and climbed to fifth in the Central, while the Avalanche dropped to 6-5-1, fourth in the Central.

items.text: Artturi Lehkonen has a point in seven straight games, with a goal in each of the last three.
The Predators bounced back after two straight losses.
Daemon Hunt made his Predators debut, after four seasons with the Wild.
NHL.com had projected the Predators with 12 forwards and six defensemen, but they dressed 11 and seven.
